component.name: PTZ Camera Control
component.summary: Control PTZ cameras directly from OBS Studio

description.p: PTZ Camera Control is an OBS Studio plugin that enables control of Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras directly from the OBS interface. It supports VISCA over UDP and TCP, ONVIF, and USB camera protocols. The plugin provides a control dock with pan/tilt/zoom controls, camera presets, and the ability to switch between multiple PTZ cameras.
